subject: How to enable authentication for the web server created by package shiny

messages.author: 6b7fa9e33c2e8fa9
messages.subject: How to enable authentication for the web server created by package shiny
parts:
Hi All,

I tried to use shiny to build a web interface to R, which was easy and quick.

A question is: how to add authentication (i.e., login with user name and password) to it on a Linux server? I searched with google and found that most access control of web server on Linux is for Apache, and could not figure out how to enable authentication for the web server created by shiny. Any suggestions will be appreciated.

Thanks
Yanchang Zhao
http://www.RDataMining.com/

messages.author: aa2f6d809dba9cb7
messages.subject: Re: How to enable authentication for the web server created by package shiny
parts:
Hi,

Shiny does not support authentication at the moment. I seems like it will be added in the future at least in the commercial version. 
If you are interested in a fast and ugly solution, including passing the provided username to the shiny application, have a look at my posts over here:
https://groups.google.com/d/msg/shiny-discuss/3HbwHXBTzNo/eeeddh-uDXoJ

FloE
